claim.text: The migration chain disables runtime table/column DML on organizations, projects, GSC connections/jobs/metrics during the cleanup barrier, blocks parent cascades, then restores those five tables' runtime DML after guards are removed without PUBLIC write ACLs. Credential and OAuth-state direct writes are outside this fence.
claim.gate: Run the full DB package suite against disposable PostgreSQL after applying migrations; inspect the targeted malicious PUBLIC-ACL fixture, migration order, parent-cascade tests, and effective privilege/schema assertions for the five protected tables.

payload.challenge: Verified the exact five-table scope against captured migrations, adversarial PostgreSQL fixtures, parent cascade cases, effective ACL assertions, and 75/75 uncached DB tests. Confirmed credentials and OAuth-state direct writes are outside this fence as stated.
